info.title: Niyat API
info.description: Provider-neutral Gate 2 private-alpha contract. AI output never grants authorization.

post.description: Invite-only. Always answers 202 for a well-formed email so membership cannot be probed. Requires the Origin header to match the app origin.

202.description: A link was sent if the address may sign in

post.description: Consumes a single-use token (15 minute lifetime) and opens a session via Set-Cookie. POST rather than GET so mail scanners that prefetch links cannot consume it.

suspend.description: Only with status resolved; suspends the reported member and revokes their sessions

post.description: Useful-match rating used for the Gate 2 exit metric. Re-rating replaces the previous answer.

sessionCookie.name: niyat_session
sessionCookie.description: HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax opaque revocable session; Secure is required in production

csrfToken.description: Double-submit token required in X-CSRF-Token for mutations

status.description: A pending request past expiresAt is reported as expired

counterpart.description: Null when a block hides the other participant

MatchCounterpart.description: The other side of a match. displayName stays null until an intro on this match is accepted.

current.description: True when 18+ is confirmed and the current terms version is accepted. Mutations other than profile and consent return 403 consent_required until then.

introRequests.description: Email when someone asks for an intro

introResponses.description: Email when your intro is accepted

outcomes.description: Email for outcome verification requests and decisions

ModerationReport.description: Moderator-only view. The reporter's identity is not exposed.
